Name: Maggs Emo Sebastian Seasonal Outfits Sprites and Portraits
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
Full pack of seasonal, festival, and alternate sprites with matching portraits for Sebastian.[/b][/size]
Options include mid-length (like vanilla) or long hair, hair colors: black, red, and dyed with red roots with an option to have the hair dynamically grow out by season with a dialogue mention, several accessories and piercing options (for portraits), unique outfits for all festivals plus options for the Flower Dance, Moonlight Jellies, and Spirit's Eve, a bonus seasonal cowboy outfit, pajamas with warm weather options, beach white tee or shirtless, smoking options for non-smoking, and more little surprises!

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218459.png[/img]
[/size][/color][/b]See the images for examples of the options.
Mid-length or long hair, with color options: black, red, or dyed black with red roots
Dynamic hair option: dyed hair grows out (black in spring and fall, grown out with roots in summer and winter)
Skin tone varies for natural black hair and natural red hair
Hoodie color options: dark color tones (for black hair only), gray and black for all hair colors
Dynamic hood up in rain/snow
Smoking option adds a video game or lollipop animation if non-smoking (does not remove smoking dialogue, use [b]Magg's Non-Smoking Sebastian[/b] for this)
Festival outfits with options for Flower Dance, Moonlight Jellies, and Spirit's Eve
Cowboy seasonal outfit
Wedding suit
Accessories
[list]
[*]Piercings - mix and match: choose as many as you like! 
[*]Eyeliner
[*]Glasses
[*]Beard - full beard, or 5 o'clock shadow
[*][b][color=#6aa84f]Frog Buddy: A little frog follows Sebby around![/color][/b]
[/list][b][size=4]
[/size][/b]Includes an option to blend with the "Seasonal Outfits Slightly Cuter" mod body style (removes leg gap, chibi style but keeps my head/hair style), if you have both mods installed, toggle Sebastian off in the Seasonal Outfits mod to avoid possible conflicts.
[size=4]
[/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218055.png[/img]
This sprite mod is fully stand-alone, but is also compatible with all of Magg's mods:
[list]
[*][b]Non-Smoking Sebastian:[/b] Select "Non-smoking" in the configuration menu.
[*][b]Immersive Sebastian: [/b]Select the same smoking option in the configuration menu as you have for Immersive Seb, either Smoking or Quit Smoking. 
[*][b]Immersive Sam:[/b] No specific settings needed.
[*][b]Custom Sprite Patch: [/b]If you want the Sebastian sprites from this mod, just turn off Seb's sprites in the Custom Sprite patch. All of Seb's custom event sprites are included in this mod.
[/list]
Special thanks to Owanora for the long hair Sebastian sprite inspiration, the sprite on this mod is a slightly altered variation.
